Remarks

This class is used to define a rectangle in a transformed space. The alignment can be customized using an AnchorPoint.

Constructors

RectShape(Transform2D)

Initializes a new instance of the RectShape class with a default alignment.

public RectShape(Transform2D offset)

Parameters

offset Transform2D

The Transform2D offset to apply to the shape, specifying position, rotation, and scale.

Remarks

The alignment anchor will be set to its default value.

RectShape(Transform2D, AnchorPoint)

Initializes a new instance of the RectShape class with a specified alignment.

public RectShape(Transform2D offset, AnchorPoint alignment)

Parameters

offset Transform2D

The Transform2D offset to apply to the shape, specifying position, rotation, and scale.

alignment AnchorPoint

The AnchorPoint to use for alignment, determining how the rectangle is anchored.

Remarks

Use this constructor to explicitly set the alignment anchor point.

Properties

Alignment

Gets or sets the alignment anchor point for the rectangle. Determines how the rectangle is positioned relative to its transform.

public AnchorPoint Alignment { get; set; }

Property Value

AnchorPoint

Remarks

The AnchorPoint specifies the reference point for alignment, such as center, top-left, etc.
